questions.topic: 变量在运算、比较和逻辑中的综合应用
questions.description: 定义 a=10、b=3，把六种算术运算结果存入列表并逐行输出。
questions.code_template:
a = 10
b = 3
# 请把 a+b、a-b、a*b、a/b、a//b、a%b 存入列表并逐行输出
___ = [a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, a // b, a % b]
for r in ___:
    print(r)
questions.hints: 先算六种结果存列表，再遍历输出。
questions.solution:
a = 10
b = 3
results = [a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, a // b, a % b]
for r in results:
    print(r)

questions.description: 循环累加并把每次结果收集到列表输出。
questions.code_template:
total = 0
sums = []
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
    sums.___(total)
print(sums)
questions.solution:
total = 0
sums = []
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
    sums.append(total)
print(sums)
